name: sureshmayanglambam/surexcore
description: SurexCore — a lightweight CMS for shared hosting on CodeIgniter 4 + Blade: content types with a field builder, media library, preview, backups and a web installer.

post-create-project-cmd: @php -r "echo PHP_EOL, '  SurexCore is ready.', PHP_EOL, '  Next:  cd into the project folder and run   php spark serve', PHP_EOL, '         then open http://localhost:8080 - the installer sets up the database and the first admin.', PHP_EOL, PHP_EOL;"
